answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The ocean holds work receipts rather than names, so the river of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the kernel of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
